events.name: Bash
events.head: Run probe-guides per guide with a watchdog
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; for g in s5-follow-ups s5-extra-pipelines s5-challenge-stages s2-tantra-pro-funnel s5-crm-starter; do echo "== $g"; ( WIDTHS=1440,390 THEMES=light node scripts/probe-guides.mjs "http://localhost:4322/debug/guides?only=$g" 2>&1 | tail -2 | cut -c1-200 ) & pid=$!; ( sleep 150; kill $pid 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "only=$g" ) & w=$!; wait $pid; kill $w 2>/dev/null; done
